title: pytest 9.2: test ids for long string parameters
prompt:
The parametrized tests in tests/test_slugs.py have long string parameters, and pytest's automatic test ids for them are unhelpful (they fall back to `text0`, `text1`). Configure pytest in a pytest.ini so that a long string parameter gets the SHA-256 hex digest of its value as its test id, while short strings keep their own value as their id. Configuration only: do not edit the tests and do not pass ids yourself.
Package versions in this environment are fixed: click 8.5.1, pytest 9.2.0, anyio 4.16.0.

source.note: Written by us for the Tavily on/off comparison; not from any public benchmark.
